description: gmas plugin hooks: detect GMC and GMAS in the project and inject context. One command line valid in both sh and PowerShell: sh (macOS, Linux, Windows with Git Bash) runs gmas-context.sh and exits; PowerShell (Windows without Git Bash) reads the sh part as one quoted argument of a no-op and runs gmas-context.ps1.

hooks.command: set gmas_hook \"; bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gmas-context.sh"; exit $?; \"; powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/gmas-context.ps1"
